task_question: Given one bounded typed relation graph and several typed candidate graphs in different declared domains, enumerate and rank role-compatible directed structural correspondences under a caller-declared relation map.
comparison_method: Compared the candidate's actual input/output contract and focused real-tool result with the exact declared capabilities of the two nearest existing toolbox entries. The same requested graph-enumeration output is the unit of comparison; an entry that cannot accept the typed graph set or emit ranked node maps is recorded as non-equivalent rather than treated as a failed score.

compared_entries.observed_task_fit: The Current operation queries registered object/function/non-function identities for exact or canonical collisions. It does not take arbitrary source and target relation graphs or produce node mappings, relation coverage, or analogy ranks.
compared_entries.reason_not_scored: No shared typed graph-search request/output contract; a numeric score would compare different outputs.

compared_entries.observed_task_fit: The optional preflight checks a caller-authored, source-backed proposal and explicit relation map, counterevidence, and falsifiers. It does not enumerate node correspondences across a target-candidate set or rank exact directed graph overlap.
compared_entries.reason_not_scored: It checks evidence structure after candidate formulation; the graph enumeration request is outside its declared input/output contract.

candidate_observation.outcome: The exact role- and direction-preserving candidate ranked first; an extra mapped edge lowered target precision; reversed edges produced no mapped overlap. The emitted transfer hypotheses require target-domain validation.
limitations: The graphs are a controlled repository-local toolbox-gap example, not an external scientific or domain-validated analogy.
No latency or memory advantage over another tool was measured.
The current and optional neighbors remain useful for their distinct identity-collision and evidence-preflight tasks.

comparison_evidence.unique_remaining_use_case: Enumerate and rank exact directed structural correspondences across finite caller-supplied graphs before a separate source and target-domain validation step.
comparison_evidence.basis: The actual task example demonstrates a bounded, distinct graph-enumeration output. Existing neighbors do not implement the same output contract and retain their own useful identity-collision and evidence-validation roles. This supports coexistence, not a claim of broad superiority or a measured net benefit.
comparison_evidence.next_comparison_trigger: Reassess only when a toolbox entry accepts equivalent typed source/candidate graphs and relation mappings and emits comparable ranked correspondences, or when a real consumer supplies a task where one of the present neighbors can perform the same output.
